CREATE TABLE research_full_ob_smoke.full_ob_gap_audit_packets_v1
(
    `packet_sha256` FixedString(64),
    `source_line_number` UInt64,
    `message_type` LowCardinality(String),
    `marker_type` Nullable(String),
    `topic` String,
    `flight_phase` Nullable(String),
    `apply_outcome` Nullable(String),
    `exchange_ts_ms` Nullable(Int64),
    `cts_ms` Nullable(Int64),
    `receive_time_ns` Nullable(Int64),
    `update_id` Nullable(Int64),
    `seq` Nullable(Int64),
    `bid_n` UInt32,
    `ask_n` UInt32,
    `bids` Array(Tuple(
        String,
        String)),
    `asks` Array(Tuple(
        String,
        String)),
    `ingestion_ts` DateTime64(3, 'UTC')
)
ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ingestion_ts)
ORDER BY (packet_sha256)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

CREATE VIEW research_full_ob_smoke.v_full_ob_gap_audit_packets_dedup
(
    `packet_sha256` FixedString(64),
    `source_line_number` UInt64,
    `message_type` String,
    `update_id` Nullable(Int64),
    `seq` Nullable(Int64),
    `bid_n` UInt32,
    `ask_n` UInt32
)
AS SELECT
    packet_sha256,
    argMax(source_line_number, ingestion_ts) AS source_line_number,
    argMax(message_type, ingestion_ts) AS message_type,
    argMax(update_id, ingestion_ts) AS update_id,
    argMax(seq, ingestion_ts) AS seq,
    argMax(bid_n, ingestion_ts) AS bid_n,
    argMax(ask_n, ingestion_ts) AS ask_n
FROM research_full_ob_smoke.full_ob_gap_audit_packets_v1_dedupdemo
GROUP BY packet_sha256
